caption: The video captures a wide, open-ocean view beneath a bright, partly cloudy sky. A flat horizon line sits near the vertical middle, separating deep blue water below from pale blue sky filled with scattered cumulus clouds above. Sunlight produces a broad, glittering band of specular reflection on the water surface, brightest just below the horizon and fading toward the foreground, where small dark wave crests and ripples are visible. The sea surface continuously undulates, with foreground crests and ripples shifting position and shape. The glittering reflection band flickers and reorganizes its sparkle pattern as the waves move, while its overall location and extent remain stable. The framing is essentially constant, and no object enters or leaves the scene. The horizon, cloud arrangement, and reflective band persist across the visible portion.
